title.en: Design of a Web-Based Scheduling Information System Using the Design Thinking Framework for Warehouse Distribution Processes
title.id: Perancangan Sistem Informasi Penjadwalan Berbasis Website Menggunakan Framework Design Thinking pada Proses Distribusi di Warehouse

overview.en: Designed and built the Warehouse Appointment Scheduling System (WASS), a web-based vendor arrival scheduling system that replaces manual coordination over chat and phone with centralized time-slot booking. Combining Design Thinking with Rapid Application Development, I traced the root causes of the inbound warehouse bottleneck and developed the solution over three iterations with users, through to deployment on Vercel. Key features include slot booking two days ahead (D-2), a dock capacity monitoring dashboard, admin slot blocking, and digital tickets sent automatically to the vendor's email. The system passed every Black Box Testing scenario and scored 85.45 on the System Usability Scale (Grade A – Excellent).
overview.id: Merancang dan membangun Warehouse Appointment Scheduling System (WASS), sistem penjadwalan kedatangan vendor berbasis web yang menggantikan koordinasi manual via chat dan telepon dengan time-slot booking terpusat. Lewat pendekatan Design Thinking yang dipadukan dengan Rapid Application Development, saya menelusuri akar masalah bottleneck di proses inbound warehouse, lalu mengembangkan solusinya dalam tiga iterasi bersama pengguna hingga di-deploy di Vercel. Fitur utamanya meliputi booking slot H-2, dashboard monitoring kapasitas dock, blokir slot oleh admin, dan tiket digital yang otomatis terkirim ke email vendor. Sistem lolos seluruh skenario Black Box Testing dan meraih skor SUS 85,45 (Grade A – Excellent).
